title: Imported services booked as expenses, through cross-border payments
scope: Close the TAX-118 miss where foreign fees booked as general expenses escape the three-way match, using the central bank cross-border payment contract

acceptance.text: Cross-border payments without matching imported-services VAT or withholding become questions, not conclusions
Re-measured detection and false positives for imported services
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
